answer: The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a dawn seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. The echo receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. A pre-written answer bank as a result goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 67 aliases trips the duplicate check at the quartz gate. Each impostor pays 2 dollars up front. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
